To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) elaboration on potential outcome (EPO) is a new construct dealing specifically with the extent to which individuals generate and evaluate potential outcomes of their behaviors, (b) EPO is related to conceptually related traits, (c) individuals with high levels of EPO engage in more effective self-regulatory behaviors than individuals with low levels of EPO, and (d) EPO can be temporarily improved by a prime.
Elaboration on potential outcomes is an individual trait, which can be measured and is related to self-regulation.
